topic: The Daily Habit Ep 7: today's 8 stories (Binance hack began with a fake job; Rupee slips to 94.55 per dollar; Voyager 1 nears one light-day; Apple to let apps pitch at cancel; Google widens voluntary buyouts; Giant AI claims to run on one CPU; Canva shake-up affects 1,271 staff; GTA 6 pre-load: 212 GB)
angle_hint: An episode digest carousel: slide 1 a bold hook naming the biggest story and that there are 8 stories today; then one stat, compare or fact slide per story for the first five stories in the episode's order (each with its own source); a close slide inviting people to watch the full episode for all of them.

facts.text: Binance says about $6.34 billion in digital assets was stolen on October 29, 2026.

The attack began in September when a software engineer was contacted through a legitimate job-hunting platform by someone impersonating a Project Director at a fictitious company. The fake recruiter scheduled two interviews: first with someone posing as an HR representative (live video call), then with someone claiming to be the CEO, held on a social chat application, where the employee was told to download a coding assignment from an online code repository.
The assignment hid previously unseen custom malware that antivirus did not detect.
By October 20 the attackers used the laptop and an internal AI tool to compromise two more wallet-team employees, then used their credentials to reach the wallet signing service on October 29.

The FBI attributes the attack to North Korean state-sponsored hackers (TraderTraitor/Lazarus). As of Nov 3, about $2.85 billion of stolen assets was frozen or intercepted; as of Oct 31, 98% of impacted token assets had been replenished.
In a Reuters poll of 37 FX strategists (Nov 2–4), the median forecast sees the rupee weakening from about 94.70 per dollar to 96.00 by end-January and 96.33 by end-April.
The rupee is down 5% this year and hit a record low of 96.96 per dollar in May.
BofA is the most bearish, calling for 99 per dollar within 12 months. Morgan Stanley expects a record low in early 2027. No respondent expects the rupee to breach 100.

The pressures are higher oil prices (India is the world's third-largest energy importer) and record foreign investor outflows. The RBI's latest measures have raised hedging costs, which makes it harder for foreign investors to come back.
Forex reserves have fallen to $719.75bn, and forward dollar liabilities are at a record $239.2bn.
On Nov 5 the rupee fell 9 paise to 94.55 against the dollar in early trade. The previous close was 94.46 after a 29-paise gain.
Voyager 1 reaches one light-day from Earth at 12:16:07 a.m. CST on November 18, 2026, according to NASA.
One light-day is about 16.1 billion miles (25.9 billion km), or 173.14 AU.
Voyager 1 launched September 5, 1977. The trip to one light-day took 49 years, 2 months and 11 days.
A one-way message to Voyager 1 will take about a day. Voyager 2 reaches one light-day in November 2035.
Most instruments on the Voyagers no longer work. NASA turned off the LECP instrument in April 2026 to save power.
Apple's Retention Messaging tool lets developers reach subscribers at the moment they choose to cancel, with custom messages about the subscription's value, images and an optional special offer.
Developers can set it up in App Store Connect or via a new Retention Messaging API for real-time interaction; MacRumors says it arrives this fall (announced at WWDC 2026).

Apps can show a simple static message, dynamic progress based on the user's app state, or a special offer (Apple's example: three months free, or promoting annual-plan discounts), in a card labelled 'from the developer'.

It appears when a user goes to cancel in the Settings Subscriptions screen, before they confirm the cancellation, with the Cancel Subscription button always prominently visible. It applies to subscriptions managed through Apple's In-App Purchase system. As of the article, it was a pre-release feature requiring developers to register interest.
Google has offered voluntary exit packages since June 2026 to some employees in Canada, France, Germany, Japan and Switzerland, widening a scheme already run in the US and UK.
Swiss staff were offered one month's pay for each year worked, capped at one year's salary.
DeepMind was left out of the Swiss scheme; earlier rounds also excluded Google Cloud and DeepMind.
Reuters could not establish how many people took up the offers; in one team of roughly 50, at least four signed up, according to one of the sources.
Last week, Microsoft offered buyouts to 60,000 employees. The Reuters report was published on the day of the article, but the page gives no date.
The repo FareedKhan-dev/kimi-k3-in-c describes itself as a 2.78-trillion-parameter Kimi K3 running inference on a single CPU in 8.24 GB of RAM.
It is written in portable C99 with no BLAS, no framework and no GPU.
The repo shows about 11.3k stars and 1.8k forks, under an Apache-2.0 license.
Repo topics include mxfp4, quantization, mixture-of-experts, linear-attention and avx2, which hint at 4-bit weights and x86 SIMD. The page does not spell this out.
The repo is hosted under the user account FareedKhan-dev, with no Moonshot affiliation shown on the page. No releases appear under the Releases heading.
As many as 1,271 Canva staff, or 22% of headcount, will be affected by layoffs, role changes or relocations.
Perkins wrote: "This is without doubt the hardest moment in our thirteen-year history." She also said: "This has been our hardest year yet."

Reasons given: growth has slowed for the first time in a decade, and there is concern design firms may lose business to AI tools. Canva will merge some functions and make Sydney the main home for more product teams.
Affected staff get at least six months' salary plus a year of healthcare cover, and Canva will launch a fund of US$10,000 grants for departing staff starting businesses.
From January, most hybrid Canva staff will be expected in the office two to three days a week.
Rockstar has confirmed the GTA 6 pre-load file will require up to 212 GB depending on your device (PS5 and Xbox Series X|S), so players need ample space for digital pre-loading.
Digital pre-loads on PS5 and Xbox begin 9 days before launch (headline); the search summary gives the pre-load date as Nov 10.
Pre-loading opens earlier than previously announced for digital orders.
Tech Insider's own pieces cover the 212GB size and say the pre-load was moved up two days (from Nov 12).

cautions: Could not open the Guardian, BBC or FT pages; facts are from BleepingComputer, which reports Binance's own disclosure. Search summaries of other outlets agree but were not read directly.
Only one page was read in full; Axios returned 403, so there is no second independent read.
Binance has not formally tied the employee compromise to a specific North Korean campaign; the FBI attribution is separate.
Figure is $6.3bn in some outlets and $6.34bn in others.
Do not say customers lost money: 98% of impacted token assets were replenished, but the source says little more on customer impact.
Some reports give different start dates for the attack (September vs June); BleepingComputer says September.
I could not open the Reuters page itself. The poll facts come from Gulf Times' republication of the Reuters story, dated Nov 4, 2026.
The 94.55 figure is from a PTI report on Nov 5 (via Telangana Today). I only saw it in search-result excerpts, not on the page. It is a different report from the Reuters poll.
These are median forecasts from a poll, not certainties. Nobody in the poll expects the rupee to pass 100 per dollar.
The rupee is near 95 largely because of regular RBI intervention. The RBI says it has no target level and only curbs volatility. Analysts' views on that differ.
The rupee touched a two-week high on Wednesday after US Democrats won majorities in the Senate and House. So the slide has not yet resumed, and the poll is a forecast.
The milestone has NOT happened yet as of Nov 9, 2026. Say 'will reach' on Nov 18, not 'has reached'.
